verses.1: Who will give me shelter in the desert? I will leave my people and go away from them, because they are all full of deceit and lies.
verses.2: And they went along their evil paths, with falsehood and not truth. They wandered around the earth from one evil place to another. They did not know me at all, says Jehovah.
verses.3: Do not trust anyone who is his enemy. Do not rely on any brother at all, for every brother is like Jacob: a cunning person who will deceive others.
verses.4: And those who are his enemies will be destroyed. They will not speak the truth, but instead, they will spread falsehoods to deceive others.
verses.5: You sit within deception, in deceitfulness. But we know the truth about you, O LORD.
verses.6: Therefore, the Lord God said, “I will bring them forth in a time of need, just as I did with my people’s daughter.”
verses.7: He spoke falsely to them. His words were false. He tried to deceive his neighbor. He spoke in a way that was not true.
verses.8: These people shall not be punished by Jehovah. But in a country like that, their souls will not be saved.
verses.9: On the mountains, I will cry out in despair. On the shores of the desert, I will wail because they have been left behind by those who passed by. They did not hear the sound of birds singing from the heavens. Even the animals were lost and gone.
verses.10: And I will give Jerusalem to the Philistines, and all the cities of Judah will be given over to them. They will have no one to protect them.
verses.11: Who is this wise man who can do this? He who speaks what Jehovah has said to him. He will tell us what caused the land to be destroyed, turning into a desert.
verses.12: And the LORD said about those who abandoned My Torah that He had given them: “They did not listen to My voice, and they did not follow My teachings.”
verses.13: And they followed the desires of their hearts, and also those of their fathers who taught them.
verses.14: Therefore, as the Lord, the God of Israel, says: “I will feed this people with food, and I will satisfy them with water from heaven.”
verses.15: And I will scatter them among nations whom they and their fathers did not know. And I will send destruction upon them to their very roots.
verses.16: So said Jehovah, the armies of heaven: “Let them arise and call upon their creators. Then they will come forth.” And let those who are wise be sent out as well; then they will also come forth.
verses.17: And it rushed upon us, and it covered us with its darkness. Our eyes became blurred, and our eyelids began to tear up water.
verses.18: For the sound of our cries can be heard from Zion. How greatly we were deceived! We left our land, as if they had abandoned our homes.
verses.19: For if women listen to the words of Jehovah and take them into their ears, and teach them to their daughters, then a wicked woman will be born.
verses.20: For death has risen among us in our homes, to destroy those who are far away from us.
verses.21: This is what the LORD has said: The sin of man has fallen like a thunderbolt upon his face. He has been cast aside from behind the thorns; there is no one to save him.
verses.22: Thus said Jehovah: Let the wise not boast in their wisdom, and let the rich not boast in their wealth.
verses.23: For in this way, the Lord will speak, and He will know that I am Jehovah, who acts with mercy and righteousness on this earth. For this is what I desire, says Jehovah.
verses.24: Now, days are coming, says the LORD. I will deal with all those who are evil in this city.
verses.25: Upon Egypt, upon Judah, upon Adam, upon the sons of Ham, upon Noah, and upon all those who dwell in the wilderness. For all the nations are destroyed, and all of Israel is a people of destruction.
